gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.lede: Where we fall short of an obligation. Each gap has an owner, a target date and a way out: fix it, or have someone else accept the risk.
gaps.filters.label: Filter gaps
gaps.empty.title: No gaps recorded
gaps.empty.body: A gap is recorded from an obligation, usually when its status lands on Gap or Partly compliant.
gaps.noMatch.title: No gaps match these filters
gaps.noMatch.body: Widen a filter or clear them all.
gaps.target.future: Target {date}, in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
gaps.target.overdue: Target {date}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue
gaps.form.title: Title
gaps.form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. No criteria for the yearly assessment of paid research
gaps.form.targetPast: Pick a date from today on.
gaps.form.planPlaceholder: What will be done, by whom and by when
gaps.way.title: Way out
gaps.way.open: Start the fix, or ask someone else to accept the risk as it is.
gaps.way.remediating: Close the gap once the plan is carried out, then re-assess the obligation.
gaps.way.readOpen: The gap is open. {owner} owns it.
gaps.way.readRemediating: Remediation is under way. {owner} owns it.
gaps.way.youAsked: You asked to accept the risk on {date}.
gaps.way.ownRequest: You asked for this, so someone else has to approve it.
gaps.way.accepted: Risk accepted by {approver} on {date}, asked by {requester}.
gaps.way.closed: The gap is closed. Re-assess the obligation so its status shows the fix.
gaps.closeDialog.title: Close this gap?
gaps.closeDialog.body: The gap reads Closed in your name. Re-assess the obligation afterwards so its status shows the fix.
gaps.acceptDialog.title: Ask to accept the risk
gaps.acceptDialog.body: Someone else who may accept risk decides. Until then the gap stays open.
gaps.acceptDialog.hint: Say more in the remediation plan if the approver needs it.
gaps.approveDialog.title: Accept the risk of "{title}"?
gaps.approveDialog.body: The gap stops counting as open work. It stays on the obligation, and anyone who may edit gaps can reopen it.
gaps.reopenDialog.title: Reopen this gap?
gaps.reopenDialog.body: The gap reads Open again, with its owner, target date and plan as they were.
gaps.problem.fourEyes: You asked for this, so someone else has to approve it.
gaps.problem.stale: Someone changed this gap while you were editing. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.
gaps.problem.movedOn: This gap has moved on: it is no longer waiting for approval.
gaps.problem.pending: Someone has already asked to accept this risk.
gaps.problem.notApprover: Only someone who may accept risk can approve this.
gaps.problem.stepUp: Confirm with your passkey to approve. The confirmation was cancelled or timed out.
gaps.problem.doesNotApply: The obligation does not apply here, so no gap can be recorded on it.
